topic.question_zh: 有编程背景怎样学习物理：概念、推导、习题和仿真各用什么？
topic.description_zh: 分别呈现概念讲座、理论物理、书面讲义与可运行数值模拟；对Feynman是否适合作为第一教材保留相反体验。

resources.title: The Feynman Lectures on Physics
resources.summary_zh: 覆盖经典物理、电磁学与量子力学，以解释与直觉见长。适合数学基础较好的读者补充视角，也有人把它作为自学入口。
resources.prerequisites_zh: 建议微积分和初等物理；量子力学卷对初学者更难。
resources.why_recommended_zh: stared与alex_smart报告高中自学的正面体验；另有读者认为它不适合作为唯一入门教材，意见分歧应保留。

evidence.quote: I self-studied physics when I was a high-school student. I read The Feynman Lectures of Physics, and it was a great introduction (especially Vol 1 and 2; Vol 3 gives interesting insights but I wouldn't treat is like a canon of quantum physics).
evidence.reason_zh: stared自述高中自学，推荐前两卷并对第三卷作限定。
evidence.author: stared

evidence.quote: As a counterpoint, I am someone who did self-learn physics from Feynman's lectures as a teenager and I would highly recommend it to others to at least give it a try.
evidence.reason_zh: alex_smart提供与批评者不同的高中自学体验。
evidence.author: alex_smart

evidence.quote: I've read about a 1/3 of the series and while I have to say they are some of the greatest technical writing in history, they are not the greatest pedagogical material.
evidence.reason_zh: PheonixPharts读约三分之一后认为文字优秀但教学效果未必适合自己。
evidence.author: PheonixPharts

resources.notes_zh: 主体是书面讲义，不是完整录像课。读者对入门适合度意见相反；建议配合习题和其他教材。
resources.format_detail_zh: 物理讲义／在线教材（原课堂讲座整理）

resources.title: The Theoretical Minimum
resources.summary_zh: 以相对精简的数学框架学习经典力学、量子力学等理论物理，适合已有STEM基础并愿意跟推导的人。
resources.prerequisites_zh: 建议微积分与线性代数；不同子课先修不同。
resources.why_recommended_zh: timnic认为讲解基础很容易进入；j_crick喜欢经典和量子力学讲座；gusfrehse特别推荐引入较重数学的量子部分。

evidence.quote: The Theoretical Minimum lecture series on theoretical physics by Leonard Susskind. Covers the basics in a very approachable way. I wish this had been available when I studied physics.
evidence.reason_zh: timnic喜欢可进入的讲法，并与自己当年学习物理的经历比较。
evidence.author: timnic

evidence.quote: I really liked The Theoretical Minimum lectures on classical and quantum mechanics by Leonard Susskind (suggestion: google up the guy, he’s cool) at Stanford. You can buy books, but the lectures are all free on YouTube.
evidence.reason_zh: j_crick喜欢经典与量子讲座，同时指出没有人发作业和成绩。
evidence.author: j_crick

evidence.quote: Can vouch for the quantum mechanics one. Perfectly understandable while introducing heavy math machinery.
evidence.author: gusfrehse

resources.notes_zh: 这是多门讲座系列，不是一个带统一评分、证书的MOOC。这里推荐讲座入口，未把配套书和每个子课逐项重复计数。
resources.format_detail_zh: 理论物理讲座系列，另有同名配套书

resources.title: Structure and Interpretation of Classical Mechanics
resources.provider: Gerald Jay Sussman、Jack Wisdom 等 / MIT
resources.summary_zh: 借程序表达并探索经典力学，适合有编程背景、想把拉格朗日力学与可运行模型联系起来的人。
resources.prerequisites_zh: 建议微积分、基本经典力学与函数式编程；历史示例依赖MIT Scheme体系。
resources.why_recommended_zh: thatcherc说这本书是自己从CS转向物理的重要原因；PheonixPharts也很喜欢，但提醒实现依赖特定库和Scheme环境。

evidence.resource_title: Structure and Interpretation of Classical Mechanics
evidence.quote: Structure and Interpretation of Classical Mechanics is so cool - I highly recommend it, especially to someone with a programming background. It's one of the main reasons I switched from CS to physics in college.
evidence.reason_zh: thatcherc直接推荐给编程背景者，并叙述转专业影响。
evidence.author: thatcherc

evidence.resource_title: Structure and Interpretation of Classical Mechanics
evidence.quote: I'm a huge fan of that book, but am very glad you called it out as more people should know about it. there's also a great companion book "Functional Differential Geometry". My one caveat with that approach is it requires a very specific implementation of their library in MIT Scheme.
evidence.reason_zh: PheonixPharts的正面评价附带环境限制。
evidence.author: PheonixPharts

resources.notes_zh: 31549597仅略读序言、计划未来学习，所以只用于确认原始链接，不用作完成者推荐。书可自学，但实现环境可能增加门槛。
resources.format_detail_zh: 可在线阅读的教材＋程序化力学练习

link_check.page_title: Structure and Interpretation of Classical Mechanics

resources.title: CFD Python: 12 steps to Navier–Stokes
resources.summary_zh: 用Python和小型数值实验逐步理解流体方程与数值求解，适合希望先从代码连接物理表达的程序员。
resources.prerequisites_zh: 建议Python/NumPy、微积分及基本数值方法；它只覆盖流体这一部分物理。
resources.why_recommended_zh: dave_sullivan说在读物理书后仍不明白如何编程实现，而这套教程帮助其理解代码与物理如何接起来。

evidence.quote: But then there's this, you might find it interesting, it helped me understand how everything fits together a lot more:
evidence.reason_zh: dave_sullivan报告CFD教程对建立代码与物理联系的帮助。
evidence.author: dave_sullivan

resources.notes_zh: 一条明确个人体验；未找到第二条独立推荐。它是流体模拟教程，不是完整物理本科课程。
resources.format_detail_zh: 开源notebook教程／计算流体动力学入门

link_check.page_title: GitHub - barbagroup/CFDPython: A sequence of Jupyter notebooks featuring the "12 Steps to Navier-Stokes" http://lorenabarba.com/ · GitHub

resources.title: Einstein's Relativity and the Quantum Revolution: Modern Physics for Non-Scientists, 2nd Edition
resources.summary_zh: 由经典物理逐步走向相对论与量子观念，适合以概念理解为主要目标、暂不追求理论物理训练的人。
resources.prerequisites_zh: 适合具备中学科学常识的观众；不是数学推导型物理本科课。
resources.why_recommended_zh: freedomben从模糊的中学物理基础出发自学，明确推荐这一门作为开头，因为从经典物理铺垫到爱因斯坦帮助了自己。

evidence.resource_title: Einstein's Relativity and the Quantum Revolution: Modern Physics for Non-Scientists, 2nd Edition
evidence.quote: This was a great one to start with because he starts with classical physics and works upward through Einstein, which helped me understand so much.
evidence.reason_zh: freedomben的个人入门体验，限定目标为广泛概念理解。
evidence.author: freedomben

resources.notes_zh: 只有一位推荐者。The Great Courses是商业讲座服务；不把帖子里当年的链接写成今天可免费旁听。此条只计所选这一门，不把同评论另外两门一起计数。
resources.format_detail_zh: 面向非专业者的商业视频讲座
